issue: Group differences reported without significance testing
impact: Six Week 5 insights were presented as comparably weighted findings when their evidential strength differs sharply
mitigation_or_resolution: All 11 relationships tested with chi-square, Cramer's V and Wilson 95% CIs (notebook Section 4)

issue: Small subgroups quoted as reliable rates (100% at 5 previous no-shows)
impact: A rate based on 3 appointments could have driven a patient-flagging policy
mitigation_or_resolution: Quantified as n=3, 95% CI 43.85-100%; withdrawn; history collapsed to 0/1/2+ bands

issue: One-variable-at-a-time analysis cannot separate real drivers from noise
impact: Weak associations could not be distinguished from spurious ones
mitigation_or_resolution: Multivariate logistic regression; five variables shown to have no independent association (notebook Section 5)

impact: Analytical findings were not reaching the modelling track
mitigation_or_resolution: Five-artefact evidence pack transferred; eight-item exchange log (notebook Section 12)

issue: KPIs described the dataset but did not support decisions
impact: Reported KPIs gave the clinic no target to act on
mitigation_or_resolution: Four KPIs validated, four decision-relevant KPIs added (notebook Section 8)

impact: The 4.22pp reminder effect remains associational; recommendation R1 is testable but not proven
mitigation_or_resolution: Not resolvable from this dataset. Week 7 T3 sensitivity analysis and T4 controlled test design

issue: 90 missing distance values, 60 missing waiting times
impact: Distance analyses run on 4,910 of 5,000 records
mitigation_or_resolution: Not imputed; documented. Pipeline must impute by median or add a missingness indicator

issue: Dataset holds no clinical or socioeconomic context
impact: Pseudo R-squared = 0.075. Likely drivers (transport cost, work commitments, cost of care) are not captured
mitigation_or_resolution: Outside the dataset. Reported as a ceiling on achievable model performance

issue: NEW: waiting_time_minutes recorded for 2,386 no-shows, mean indistinguishable from attended appointments
impact: A non-attended appointment cannot accrue a clinic waiting time; the Week 5 waiting-time analysis is not interpretable as stated
mitigation_or_resolution: Excluded from Week 6 analysis and from the DS feature set. Definition query raised against the Knowledge Base. Week 7 T7

issue: NEW: 5,000 appointments belong to only 1,696 patients; 94.0% belong to a repeat patient
impact: A random train/test split leaks patient history and inflates reported model performance
mitigation_or_resolution: Patient-grouped split (GroupKFold on patient_id) agreed; chronological holdout added as a secondary check

issue: NEW: Week 5 SMS channel recommendation is not statistically supported
impact: Acting on it would have committed clinic resources to a difference indistinguishable from chance
mitigation_or_resolution: Overall channel test p=0.087; SMS vs WhatsApp p=0.032 fails Bonferroni 0.0167. Recommendation withdrawn; Week 7 T4 proposes a controlled test

issue: NEW: reminder coverage is flat across risk levels (72.68% overall, 72.78% for 31+ day bookings)
impact: The clinic's only controllable lever is not directed at its highest-risk appointments
mitigation_or_resolution: Captured as the High-Risk Reminder Coverage Gap KPI and as recommendation R1 (660 appointments)

issue: NEW: 18 months of data contain no record of any clinic intervention
impact: No before/after comparison is possible; all findings are cross-sectional
mitigation_or_resolution: Week 7 measurement plan proposes recording intervention flags going forward
